note: Written before any Stage 11 error was computed. Addenda (constants recorded before use) are appended below, never edited.

addenda.text: E-TVA is empty: the WQP organisation search returns no TVA organisation in TN or AL, and the pool has no TVA rows. Added E-TN = every TDEC (TDECWR_WQX) Tennessee lake/reservoir Secchi row in the pool dated <= 2025-12-31, as the nearest TVA-system state source. The WQP pool starts 2018-01-01, so E-AL covers 2018-2025, not 2017-2025.

addenda.source: Kou, Labrie & Chylek 1993 (Appl. Opt. 32:3531), OMLC tabulation kou93b.dat, band-averaged over the S2A MSI V4 B07 spectral response (S2B 2.68, S2C 2.58; one value used for all platforms)
addenda.deviation: The pre-registration named 'the table shipped with ACOLITE'; ACOLITE ships no pure-water absorption beyond the visible (its WOPP file holds only the real refractive index), so the published Kou et al. table was used instead. Chosen before any P1-NIR value was computed.
